says: The required record-search CLI cannot run in a read-only plan checkout because it unconditionally fetches before searching.
proof: The plan skill requires record searches during its read-only step. records.ts:697 calls git fetch -q origin main before listing records. Running records.ts find for dev watch save rebuild reply failed because Git could not open .git/FETCH_HEAD: Operation not permitted. Calling the exported ranking functions over locally tracked records completed without fetching.
cost: A read-only planner loses the required settled-record search unless it assembles a separate read-only call.
